options.text: She may rewrite the sum as $6+10+(-4)$ without changing its value.
She may rearrange only after leaving a subtraction sign sitting between unsigned parts.
The same rearranging rule also covers multiplying grouped sums in this item.
The printed numeral $10$ alone is the rearranged value of the expression.

stem:
Komal has rewritten an expression as the sum of terms $6+(-4)+10$.

Which claim about rearranging is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Once the expression is a sum of signed terms, any order or grouping keeps the same value: 6+10+(-4)=12, matching 6+(-4)+10. The rule applies after signed terms are written, does not cover products here, and is not settled by the largest printed numeral.
